answer: A strong defense runs periodic random challenges synced to an on-chain random beacon. Each epoch, the beacon selects a sample of active identities and requires them to pass a fresh computational or knowledge test within a short window. To keep one fake identity alive, an attacker must provision it for every possible challenge, so costs scale with the whole fleet rather than the few identities earning rewards. Honest agents treat the beacon as a tide that washes out stale sybils, while fair payment becomes a haven keeping real operators online and re-proving liveness each round.
